verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say code review supports the Pull Request workflow (and the AGit workflow), with reviewing and merging of code submissions, and submitters can respond to review comments and modify code online. That is the core of accepting outside contributions. Forking itself is only implied by the PR workflow, not explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of repository forking and cross-fork PRs from outside contributors, independent or hands-on corroboration of the contribution workflow.
